{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Exclude rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
print("Number of rows before filtering biomarker_baseline == -999:", len(df))

filtered_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
print("Number of rows after filtering biomarker_baseline == -999:", len(filtered_df))

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
print("Number of unique patients before deduplication:", len(filtered_df))

deduped_df = filtered_df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

print("Number of unique patients after deduplication:", len(deduped_df))

# Final answer
num_patients = len(deduped_df)
print(num_patients)"}
